comment: Manual read at https://flagaudio.com/vcv/thorns.html; it says only that the input is split into 8 bands, each saturated and then summed, with the band amplitudes drawn as a crown over the panel art. Param 1 Tone (panel TONE) has no line: no source says what it does to the bands, so it was left to fall back to the maker's tooltip. Its attenuverter and CV jack are described, because those are certain. The HQ line rests on the maker's own wording 'Higher(4x)', which reads as a four-times oversampling setting; the line does not quote the figure. No source is published, so no ranges could be confirmed for DRIVE, TONE or the band count.
